propositions: When the tracker's checked-out branch differs from the published ref, heal_multi_bundle merges unrelated commits from the side branch into the ticket history via _fold_heads, corrupting the published ref silently.
The heal now refuses with S3DoctorConflict before downloading or merging any bundle when the tracker is not on the published ref or is in detached HEAD state.
The guard runs after the single-bundle no-op check, preserving no-op behavior for stores with nothing to heal and leaving remote bundles unmodified when refusing.
Unrelated side-branch commits no longer become reachable from the published ref after the refusal guard is applied.
Trackers correctly checked out on the published ref continue to heal losslessly with existing behavior unchanged.
